**Where to put the call:** `ModerationService.makeDecision` in `src/moderation/moderation.service.ts`. It has two branches that suspend users. Add the push right after the existing `sseService.notifyStatusChanged(...)` call in each:
- Regular users: after `src/moderation/moderation.service.ts:750-758`, using `moderation.regularUserId`.
- Verified users: after `src/moderation/moderation.service.ts:776-785`, using `moderation.verifiedUserId`.

Skip the guest branch (`:788-814`), since product only asked for regular and verified users. That branch is also the only one where a guest can be suspended but never restored.

**Which method to call:** `FcmService.sendNotificationToUser(userId, { data: { event: ... } })` at `src/fcm/fcm.service.ts:172`.
- It looks up the user's active device token and sends via `sendNotificationToToken` (`:234`).
- The existing wrappers `sendKYCNotificationToUser` (`:203`) and `sendMissedCallNotificationToUser` (`:326`) call it the same way, so I'd copy them. A new `sendSuspendedNotificationToUser` wrapper would fit that pattern.
- The payload is data-only. `sendNotificationToToken` builds `{ token, data }` with no `notification` title or body (`:255-258`), so the app has to render the push from the `event` value.
- You'd need a new value in the `EventTypes` enum (`src/fcm/enums/event-types.enum.ts`). I didn't open that file, so I haven't checked what it contains. `KYC_PASSED`, `INCOMING_CALL` and `MISSED_CALL` are the existing values the wrappers use.

**Things to handle:**
- `ModerationService` doesn't inject `FcmService` yet (constructor at `:104-116`). Import `FcmModule` in the moderation module. `FcmModule` already exports the service (`src/fcm/fcm.module.ts:12`). I didn't open `moderation.module.ts`, so I haven't confirmed it doesn't already import `FcmModule`.
- `sendNotificationToUser` throws `BadRequestException` on failure (`:193`). It returns `{ success: false }` if the user has no device token (`:182`). `makeDecision` wraps everything in a try/catch that rethrows `InternalServerErrorException` (`:829-835`). Without handling, a push failure would turn an already-applied suspension into a 500. Wrap the push in its own try/catch that logs the error, or don't await it.
- The existing `moderation.service.spec.ts` will need an `FcmService` mock provider.
